title: Canonical relative module restrictions and big etale nerve cofaces
statement: Work in the size convention [def-weil-size-convention] over a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], with categories fibred in groupoids over $\mathit{Sch}/S$ [def-sfb-stable-pointed-moduli-groupoids]. Use the big etale module categories, precomposition $a^*$, direct image $a_*$ and their defining adjunctions from [def-sfb-stack-big-etale-module-functors]. Precomposition is additive. Precomposition of a composite equals composite precomposition with its canonical ring transports. For $d:\mathcal B\to\mathcal A$, $a:\mathcal A\to\mathcal X$ and $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$, define the additive relative term $(fa)_*a^*$ and its coefficient-natural restriction $(fa)_*a^*\to(fad)_*(ad)^*$ as the adjunction mate of the restriction of the counit of $(fa)^*\dashv(fa)_*$ along $d$. For $u:\mathcal U\to\mathcal X$, use the existing common-target tuple category [def-sfb-fibred-relative-cech-complex] of $p+1$ entries as its degree-$p$ nerve, with projection $u_p$ to the common target. In degree zero this is equivalent over $\mathcal X$ to $\mathcal U$. Deleting entry $j$ is tuple reindexing along $\operatorname{Fin.succAbove}(j)$. The projections and deletion maps are functors over schemes, and every level is fibred in groupoids. Define its additive module Cech term $(fu_p)_*u_p^*$ and its coface by the preceding restriction along deletion. If $\mathcal U,\mathcal X$ are algebraic stacks [def-sfb-algebraic-moduli-stack] and $u$ is representable by algebraic spaces [def-trf-algebraic-space], every nerve level is algebraic and each $u_p$ is representable by algebraic spaces.
